# 03 · The Faith Engine
Faith-per-turn routed through converters; augurs and rites spend the rest.
Wins by: the Opus faith pillar · The Cathedral of the Age · The Hierophant.

## Æra I
- Tech:
  - Divination — unlocks Augur, Shrine, The Oracle, Rite of the Harvest, Recasting the Omens
- Orders:
  - First Rites — +2 faith in your capital.
  - Fire-Keepers — +1 faith in your capital, and +1 happiness there.
- Doctrines: —
- Religion:
  - the pantheon drafts
  - Rite of the Harvest — augur rite — +1 population
  - Omen Reading — augur rite — +15 science
- Great people: —
- Wonders:
  - Stonehenge — +1 pantheon slot · +1 faith on every hex carrying Stone or Marble · on completion, an Augur joins you
  - The Oracle — +1 faith in every city with The Oracle · +1 card in every Statecraft draft · +1 card in every Doctrine draft
- Deeds:
  - The First Faith — The first religion founded in the world.

## Æra II
- Tech:
  - The High Temple — unlocks Prophet, Temple, The Preaching
  - Ancestor Rites — unlocks Ancestor Rites, Monument
- Orders:
  - Pilgrim Roads — +1 faith for every 3 citizens in your capital · +1 happiness for each 50 banked faith (at most +5).
  - Lamplighters — +1 culture for each 5 faith you gain per turn.
  - The Pilgrim's Purse — +5 faith in every city standing beside a holy site.
  - Wayside Shrines — +1 faith in every city.
  - Census of Souls — +1 faith for each citizen in your capital.
  - The Choir — +1 culture and +1 happiness in every city with a Temple.
- Doctrines:
  - The Great Litany — +1 culture for each 3 faith you gain per turn.
  - The Tithe — +1 gold for each faith you gain per turn.
  - Divine Inspiration — +1% science and +1% culture for each 200 banked faith.
- Religion:
  - founding
  - follower/enhancer drafts
  - The Preaching — augur rite — lump: {'range': 4, 'amount': 20}
  - Consecration of the Bounds — augur rite — +15 borderCulture
- Great people: the prophet (called with faith)
- Wonders:
  - The Great Ziggurat — religious units cost −25% to buy · +1 science in every city with a Shrine
- Deeds:
  - The Hierophant — Spend a great sum of faith on augurs and prophets across the game.
  - The Tithe — Gather a great sum of gold from tithes.
